articles.title: MCP for agent-to-agent comms may be the riskiest protocol you've never heard of
articles.content: Trust gaps in the new protocol spread malicious prompts from one agent to another.
articles.titleZh: 客服代表与客服代表沟通的MCP可能是您从未听说过的风险最高的协议
articles.contentZh: 新协议中的信任缺口将恶意提示从一个代理传播到另一个代理。

articles.title: Apple changes full-disk access permissions to curb abuse from AI agents
articles.content: Meta says FDA isn't sufficient to Muse reading messages. Apple begs to differ.
articles.titleZh: Apple更改全磁盘访问权限，以遏制AI代理的滥用
articles.contentZh: Meta说， FDA不足以让Muse阅读信息。苹果恕我直言。

articles.title: Hacks of 2 federal agencies in a month have spilled a bonanza of sensitive data
articles.content: It has been a bad month for federal government cybersecurity.
articles.titleZh: 一个月内2个联邦机构的黑客攻击泄露了大量敏感数据
articles.contentZh: 对于联邦政府的网络安全来说，这是一个糟糕的月份。

articles.title: Memory executives expect RAM shortage to continue through 2028
articles.content: Prices for memory sold for 2027 "are much higher than 2026 prices."
articles.titleZh: 内存高管预计RAM短缺将持续到2028年
articles.contentZh: 2027年售出的内存价格“远高于2026年的价格。”

articles.title: Gemini Call for Me might tell your mom you’re running late
articles.content: Google may be expanding its "Call for Me" AI feature beyond business calls so you can use it to send messages to friends and family. Android Authority reports finding a "Gemini Calling" introductory screen in an APK teardown with examples that include "Call Mom and tell her I will be 15 minutes late" and "Call […]
articles.titleZh: 双子座给我打电话可能会告诉你妈妈你迟到了
articles.contentZh: Google可能会将其“Call for Me”人工智能功能扩展到商务电话之外，以便您可以使用它向亲朋好友发送消息。Android Authority报告称，在APK拆解中发现了一个“Gemini Calling”介绍屏幕，其示例包括“给妈妈打电话，告诉她我会迟到15分钟”和“给[…]打电话”

articles.title: Reverse-engineered games: All the news on video game decomps, recomps, VR and web and 3D ports
articles.content: It’s a wild time for retro gaming. Thanks to decompilations and recompilations of classic titles, those games are becoming unshackled from their proprietary code and original hardware to be ported to new devices or updated in ways to completely change the original game. Ever imagined skateboarding in Call of Duty? Or playing the original Halo right […]
articles.titleZh: 逆向工程游戏：关于视频游戏分解、重构、VR、网络和3D端口的所有新闻
articles.contentZh: 现在是复古游戏的狂野时刻。由于经典游戏的反编译和重新编译，这些游戏正在从其专有代码和原始硬件中解放出来，以移植到新设备或以完全改变原始游戏的方式进行更新。有没有想过在《使命召唤》中玩滑板？或者直接播放原版《光环》[…]
